text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review research paper focused primarily on assessing the impacts of future land use change scenarios on butterfly species distributions in Switzerland, not on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction itself. The LULC scenarios used were derived from prior studies and implemented as inputs rather than being the central research objective. The paper does not perform original LULC prediction or simulation with mapped outputs; instead, it applies existing land use change scenarios to species distribution models. While it uses multiple future scenarios and spatially explicit data, the primary focus is ecological (species distribution responses), and no new national-scale LULC prediction modeling with accuracy metrics is presented. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of having primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation.)
